name: zeta-desktop
description: Electron client for the Zeta app-server protocol

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test:main: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist/test/test/*.test.js dist/test/src/base/test/common/*.test.js dist/test/src/base/test/browser/*.test.js dist/test/src/platform/theme/test/common/*.test.js dist/test/src/platform/theme/test/browser/*.test.js
scripts.dev: cargo build --manifest-path ../zeta-rs/Cargo.toml -p zeta-cli && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && concurrently -k -n renderer,main,preload,electron "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html && cross-env ZETA_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 nodemon --quiet --signal SIGTERM --watch dist/main --watch dist/preload --ext js,cjs --exec \"node scripts/run-electron.mjs\""
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html && cross-env ZETA_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 nodemon --quiet --signal SIGTERM --watch dist/main --watch dist/preload --ext js,cjs --exec "node scripts/run-electron.mjs"
